title: 高中學測英文範圍核心單字

vocabulary.example: The tour ended abruptly due to a sudden rainstorm.
vocabulary.example_translation: 旅行因為突然下雨而提前結束。

vocabulary.example: The company will acquiesce to the demands of the union.
vocabulary.example_translation: 公司會滿足工會的要求。

vocabulary.example: She felt an affinity with her new roommate.
vocabulary.example_translation: 她與新房東相處得很融洽。

vocabulary.example: Our argument alienated us from our friends.
vocabulary.example_translation: 我們的爭論使我們與朋友們變得疏遠。

vocabulary.example: The new policy will ameliorate the living conditions of the poor.
vocabulary.example_translation: 新的政策會改善貧窮的人的生活條件。

vocabulary.example: He was apprehensive about the upcoming test.
vocabulary.example_translation: 他對即將來到的考試感到忌憚。

vocabulary.example: The researcher was assiduous in collecting data.
vocabulary.example_translation: 研究員收集資料時很勤奮。

vocabulary.example: The city is a bastion of culture and art.
vocabulary.example_translation: 該城市是文化藝術的堡壘。

vocabulary.example: The earthquake caused a catastrophe in the city.
The government took a conciliatory stance towards the protest.
vocabulary.example_translation: 政府對遊行展現了一種調解的姿態。

vocabulary.example: The contrarian investor made a fortune by predicting the market downturn.
vocabulary.example_translation: 反對的投資人通過預測市場低潮賺到了大錢。

vocabulary.example: The company will deprive its employees of their bonuses.
vocabulary.example_translation: 公司會剝奪員工的獎金。

vocabulary.example: The diplomat used her diplomacy to ease the tension between countries.
vocabulary.example_translation: 外交官通過外交手段減少了兩國間的緊張局勢。

vocabulary.example: The politician was accused of being egocentric and power-hungry.
vocabulary.example_translation: 政客被指責是自我中心和追求權力欲。

vocabulary.example: The egalitarian society valued equality and fairness.
vocabulary.example_translation: 平等主義的社會重視平等和公平。
